text:
saira: heads up — canary fleet in us-west-2 started failing right after the cu12 toolkit rollout. lots of SIGABRTs and immediate pod evictions. paging alerts spiked.
alex: seeing repeated OOMKILL / crashloop with driver bind errors. k8s shows evictionReason=KernelOOM in some nodes.
saira: full log snippet:
```
2026-03-18T09:12:02Z app[pid=2345]: symbol lookup error: /opt/cuda/lib64/libcudart.so.12: undefined symbol: _ZNK7thrust5____
2026-03-18T09:12:03Z kernel: oom_reaper: reaped process 2345 (inference) total-vm:2048000kB, anon-rss:1536000kB
```
devon: canaries ahead of main rollout, right? which image tag did we push to canary?

saira: yes canary tag `redwood/runtime:canary-cu12-20260318`. only canaries so far but autoscaler sees drain signals and is throttling provisioning which is cascading into other test pools.

tim: quick hypothesis — metrics/profiler sidecar is setting LD_PRELOAD/RTLD_GLOBAL. combined with cu12 libsoname changes, we end up resolving different libstdc++ / GLIBCXX symbols at runtime and the driver crashes.

alex: grep on the node shows:
```
$ kubectl -n infra get pods -o yaml metrics-agent-xxxxx | yq '.spec.containers[0].env'
- name: LD_PRELOAD
  value: "/opt/prof/libprof.so"
- name: LD_LIBRARY_PATH
  value: "/opt/prof:/usr/local/cuda/lib64"
```

devon: ohhh, metrics-agent image got an update yesterday that added the profiler shim. it was pushed without a compatibility matrix for cu12.

saira: That explains the symbol lookup. LD_PRELOAD forces profiler lib to be used before driver libs — if libprof links a different libstdc++ it can pull conflicting symbols. When the process faults, the node's oom handling + our eviction webhook interprets it as unhealthy and drains.

tim: mitigation plan:
- remove LD_PRELOAD from the metrics-agent DaemonSet on canaries
- restart canary pods
- rollback canary image if needed
- scale up a small clean pool to validate provisioning

alex: commands:
```
kubectl -n infra set env daemonset/metrics-agent LD_PRELOAD- --context=cluster-canary
kubectl -n infra rollout restart daemonset/metrics-agent --context=cluster-canary
kubectl -n infra patch ds/metrics-agent -p '{"spec":{"template":{"metadata":{"annotations":{"rollout-timestamp":"2026-03-18T09:20Z"}}}}}' --context=cluster-canary
```

devon: i'll push a quick patch to the metrics-agent Dockerfile to gate the profiler behind `ENABLE_PROFILER` env var and cut a new tag. will also add a compatibility check to our image-promote CI.

saira: also, temporarily disable the eviction webhook for canary nodes until we validate the fix — autoscaler is aggressively evicting and making repro worse.

tim: opened a short incident ticket and added runbook steps. incident link: https://redwood.incidents/INC-2026-187

alex: cost note — we saw a short provisioning spike because autoscaler tried to replace drained nodes; team lead asked for a note for finance about a ~2hr small extra GPU usage in us-west-2 canaries.

devon: patch pushed to branch `metrics/no-preload-canary`. tagging `metrics-agent:canary-no-preload-20260318` and promoting to canary after approval.

saira: good. once canary is stable for 15m we can re-evaluate main rollout. thanks all. :thumbsup:
oncall-bot: Acknowledged — oncall incident INC-2026-187 created and rotations notified.
